items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 22 at 7:58PM EDT until September 25 at 5:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 kt and seas 4 to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...South Santee River to Edisto Beach out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 5 AM Wednesday to 5 PM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
